Jenia Florian If you have permanent status, you are not in the process anymore. And if you are still in the process, you don't have permanent status. The two are mutually exclusive.
The 3-monthish limit will remain until you reach permanent residency or citizenship, independent of your circumstances. Once you reach that point, the limit rises to 7 years (permanent residency) or no limit (citizenship). But until then, you have to play by their rules.
